answer: In an agent economy, each identity must lock a growing stake and complete a unique wander path through a shared lagoon of recent peer attestations. The path is seeded by a public comet flash (a recent settled epoch hash that cannot be predicted). Because every fake needs its own sequential path that collides on the same lagoon state, the attacker pays both stake and non-parallelizable compute per head; bulk farms cannot precompute or split the cost.
